build: dev-03c7d234f (main 03c7d234f) on both ends; prod server .30 and prod edges (two, 0.8 ms from the test host)
method: two throwaway containers on anvit (arm64), tc netem delay N ms limit 100000 on the origin container's egress, carrier restarted after the delay, python origin 100-200 MiB, second machine downloads the tunnel URL with curl through pb exec; the visitor reached whichever edge DNS returned
http_version: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 visitors give the same numbers at 50 ms, so the visitor leg is not the limit
finding: Not reached: the 50 ms median is 24.5 (loaded host) to 88 (idle host), budget 150. 25 ms gives 134-187, so the stream window does grow (a 256 KiB window would cap 25 ms at 84); the collapse at 40-50 ms is erratic and edge dependent (152.67.0.60 is the low one), which points at loss or CPU on the edge host (UDP receive buffer is quic-go's 7 MiB request against the stock 208 KiB rmem_max, nothing in deploy/ raises it), not at the window. The carrier is QUIC (ss shows UDP only), so there is no yamux layer on this path.
